title: Safe/Holding Location Mid-Range Photo (Expected Cash Bag Storage)
prompt:
1) Function (1 sentence)
Capture a forensic-quality mid-range color photograph documenting the interior of a designated safe/holding storage location where a cash bag would be expected to be stored.

2) Scene / Composition (3–5 sentences; include subject percentage in frame)
An empty, neutral-colored metal cabinet/safe interior is shown with the door open, revealing two shelves and a flat base where a cash bag would plausibly sit. The primary subject is the lower shelf and base area, occupying ~65% of the frame, with the open door edge and hinge side occupying the remaining ~35% for context. Surfaces are clean and unmarked, with no readable stickers, serial plates, or identifying text visible. The image is evenly illuminated with direct forensic flash, producing crisp detail and minimal shadowing.

3) Angle & Distance (strict numeric values)
Angle: 0° (eye-level, straight-on); subject distance: 1.20 m.

4) Optics & Technique (lens mm, f/, 1/x s, ISO, WB K, focus, DOF)
Lens: 35 mm; aperture: f/8; shutter: 1/125 s; ISO 200; white balance: 5600 K (flash). Focus: single-point on the front edge of the lower shelf; deep depth of field to keep the full cabinet interior sharp. Technique: on-axis flash with neutral color rendering and forensic-quality sharpness.

5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case)
None.

6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear)
No people, faces, hands, or body parts.
No logos, brand names, serial numbers, asset tags, or readable identifying text.
No cash, cash bag, weapons, drugs, or contraband.
No timestamps, camera labels, watermarks, or annotations.
No rulers/scale markers.
No visible location cues outside the cabinet/safe (no room signage, doors with numbers, or unique identifiers).

7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets)
- Single color photo, eye-level straight-on view into an open cabinet/safe interior.
- Lower shelf and base storage area are clearly visible and sharp.
- Subject occupies ~65% of frame; context (open door edge/hinge side) occupies ~35%.
- Even forensic-flash illumination with minimal shadows and no motion blur.
- No people, no identifying text, no brands/logos, no scales, no timestamps/overlays.
